貸暗号資産ベーシック
summary: Active fixed-term crypto-asset lending product operated by GMOコイン株式会社. Customers lend crypto assets to GMO Coin and receive lending fees under the applicable Basic course and current product rules.
what_happened: GMO Coin Lending Basic remains active in 2026, with first-party recruitment notices confirming continued intake for selected assets and terms subject to capacity. First-party records show the predecessor '貸暗号資産' service was already operating in June 2020 and underwent course/rate changes effective July 2020, but the reviewed evidence does not establish the exact original launch day. Current product disclosures characterize the transaction as a crypto-asset consumption loan, state that it is not a crypto-asset exchange transaction, state that borrowed assets are not subject to exchange-business segregated-management requirements, and warn that lent assets may not be returned if GMO Coin fails. Published lending rates, course availability and risk/operational statements are issuer terms and claims, not independent evidence of realized returns, guarantees, reserves or solvency.
uncertainty_notes: First-party materials establish the lending service by June 2020 and current operation in 2026, but do not establish a sufficiently reliable exact original launch date. Current lending rates, asset/term availability, capacity and early-termination terms can change. This record is Basic only; the separate Premium product adds derivative / yen-conversion mechanics and is not silently combined here.
notes: Promoted in Phase 10 from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000126 after candidate-only PR #221 passed the hardened full-corpus scanner with exactly one draft-eligible candidate.
